subject: Brightleaf POC kickoff - recap and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Grant <marcus.grant@brightleaf.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Brightleaf POC kickoff - recap and next steps

Hi Marcus & Olivia,

Thanks again for taking the time today  great discussion. Quick recap from our call and the proposed kickoff plan for the pilot/POC so we're all aligned. Please reply with any corrections or questions.

Pain points you shared
- Current search/chat answers are inconsistent across clinical notes and support docs (high FNR on safety-critical queries).
- Token costs are spiking due to unoptimized long-context requests and re-hydration of repeated queries.
- Hard to reproduce model regressions across environments; QA is manual and slow.

POC goals / success metrics (proposed)
- Primary: Improve answer accuracy on clinical QA benchmark from 68% -> >=82% (measured with the provided prompt set).
- Secondary: Reduce per-session token cost by 25% via caching and batching; achieve median latency < 350ms for short queries.
- Acceptance: Sign-off by product + security after evaluation run and a short SLO review.

Scope / deliverables
1) Data & prompts: We'll run an eval on your 200-case prompt set (you agreed to provide export).
2) Model config: Start with open-llm-3-8B quantized + Redwood Optimize suggestions; we'll test a fallback smaller variant for cost/latency profiling.
3) Integration: Simple API integration to mirror your current QA flow (3 endpoints: chat, embedding, rerank).
4) Monitoring: Per-route latency/cost dashboard and quality regression alerts for the prompt set.

Owners / contacts
- Brightleaf: Marcus Grant (product lead), Olivia Chen (security/compliance).
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE, main contact), Neha Kapoor (CS/Onboarding), Rishi Malhotra (Infra/Runtime).

Timeline / milestones (target)
- Week 1 (this week): Data access + SSO/KMS checklist; kick off infra provisioning.
- Week 2: Baseline eval on raw data + first integration tests.
- Week 3: Optimization pass (batching/cache/quantize), run acceptance eval.
- Week 4: Finalize results & handoff + optional extended trial.

Access / setup steps we need from Brightleaf
1) Export of the 200-case prompt set and representative docs (S3 link or secure Drive).
2) Short-term API key / test account for the non-production dataset; or VPC peering details if you prefer private.
3) Contact for SSO/KMS requests (Olivia).

Attachments
- brightleaf-poc-plan-v1.pdf (POC plan with timeline & eval specs)  attached.

Next steps
- Marcus/Olivia: confirm data export timeline and whether you want us to sign an NDA before receiving the prompt set.
- Neha: I'll follow up to schedule a technical kickoff with your engineers tomorrow.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Inference  developer-first LLM inference

Subject: Re: Brightleaf POC kickoff - recap and next steps

Thanks Marissa  this looks good and captures the discussion. Quick clarifications:
- We can share the 200-case prompt set by end of day Wednesday (S3 link).
- Security: Olivia is asking for the SOC2 attestation and a short list of data handling controls (retention + logs) before we share sensitive records. Can you include a copy or pointer to Redwood's SOC2 and the KMS/SSO checklist?
- Legal: looping in our legal team  they'll want a short MSA + the POC terms (no transfer of customer data outside our environment).

Also, one request: can we include one of our ML engineers on the technical kickoff? I'll invite Priya (cc'd in a follow-up) to the next meeting.

Appreciate it,
Marcus
Product Lead, Brightleaf Health
marcus.grant@brightleaf.com

> - Legal: looping in our legal team  they'll want a short MSA + the POC terms (no transfer of customer data outside our environment).

Hi Marcus  thanks. A few infra notes and an ask for the engineering handoff: 
- For the prompt set, S3 or pre-signed GCS link is fine. We'll need a small sample dataset (10-20 cases) ahead of the full export so we can run a local baseline.
- If you want private connectivity (recommended for PHI-ish datasets), we can do VPC peering or temporary SFTP. Please confirm which.
- KMS/SSO: we support customer-managed KMS or using Redwood-managed KMS with customer key wrap; Olivia, happy to sync to confirm requirements.

Action items for Redwood (owners):
- Rishi: infra provisioning + VPC steps (ETA 2 business days after creds).
- Neha: onboarding + evaluation config, will own prompt/eval runs.
- Marissa: contract/MSA coordination + commercial.

I'll prepare a short infra checklist and post to the shared Drive link.

- Rishi
Sr. Engineering Manager, Runtime | Redwood Inference
